papers.title: Superior fracture resistance of additive manufactured high-entropy alloy under impact loading
papers.abstract: In this study, Ni40Co18Cr18Fe14Al5Ti5 high-entropy alloys (HEAs) with a near-equiaxed grain structure and cellular substructures, devoid of significant microstructural imperfections, was produced via selective laser melting (SLM). The absence of brittle precipitates or substantial processing defects, which typically serving as fracture-weakening origins, allowed for effective activation of dislocation motion, deformation twinning, and stacking faults ahead of the crack tip. These mechanisms contributed to exceptional impact toughness (∼1600 kJ/m2) and dynamic crack initiation toughness (∼1000 kJ/m2). With an impressive yield strength (∼810 MPa), our SLM-produced HEA demonstrates a unique combination of impact toughness and strength that surpasses current additively manufactured metals.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是非生物医用高熵合金的冲击韧性，与生物医学植入物的应力屏蔽、多孔结构或疲劳性能无关。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure design for stress shielding, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration assessment, no biomedical implant context.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过SLM制备无缺陷高熵合金以获得优异冲击韧性。
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制备Ni40Co18Cr18Fe14Al5Ti5合金，并进行动态冲击测试。
summary_zh.result: 合金表现出约1600 kJ/m²的冲击韧性和约1000 kJ/m²的动态裂纹萌生韧性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验冲击测试验证力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To achieve superior impact toughness in high-entropy alloys by eliminating microstructural imperfections via selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: A Ni40Co18Cr18Fe14Al5Ti5 high-entropy alloy was fabricated by SLM and subjected to dynamic impact testing.
summary_en.result: The alloy exhibited an impact toughness of ~1600 kJ/m² and dynamic crack initiation toughness of ~1000 kJ/m².
summary_en.validation: Mechanical validation was performed through experimental impact tests.
